description.value: Michael's No Frills is a discount supermarket franchise located in Langley, BC, part of the Loblaw-owned No Frills chain known for low-price grocery staples. As a full supermarket, it offers a broad range of packaged and fresh foods that touring cyclists can use to stock up before or after longer stretches of the Fraser Valley. The store is independently franchised under the Michael's banner, a common format for No Frills locations across British Columbia.
